author: Seung Wook
problem: levels are a river gauge's daily water levels in cm. Return on how many days the level was higher than on the day before.
bug_description: previous = level is indented inside the if, so the reference level only moves on a rise and later days are compared with an old peak.

comments.accurate: Days the river was higher than on the day before
comments.wrong_behavior: Days the river rose above the last level it climbed to
comments.wrong_location: Day-to-day comparison verified; check the first reading starts the comparison
